items.text: Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
Added new bull and cow trophy models.

Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.
Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.
Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.
Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.
Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.

2026-09-18.summary:
### Livestock & Wildlife
- Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
- Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
- Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
- Added new bull and cow trophy models.
- Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
- Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
- Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.

### Inventory & Loot
- Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
- Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.

### Combat & Tools
- Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
- Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.

### UI & Dialogue
- Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
- Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
- Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
- Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.

items.text: Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant buffs such as longer duration, higher yield, increased gene chance, and extra healing.
New Brioche Bread recipe (2 eggs, 4 cream) provides a 25 % boost to bread stats.
Stone and cloth costs for several recipes have been reduced and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.
Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, including when using bows.
Low‑health heartbeat sound is louder and fades after three seconds of health loss.
Distance2D calculations now correctly ignore the Y axis, fixing range checks and related gameplay logic.
Fixed occasional NaN water level values, preventing abnormal water behavior.
Triangle foundations no longer connect buildings that only touch at a corner.
A unified 'Swap Seats' button binding has been added to all vehicle action sets.
Cars now support a reload action and the menu gesture action has been removed.
Stirring the biofuel generator mounts you in place; releasing stops mounting, and a 'no electricity' status appears if stirred without power.
New achievements added for leaving a note in another player's mailbox, purchasing from the travelling vendor, and initiating a satellite crash event.
Livestock now spread out when avoiding the trough instead of forming a line, improving their avoidance behavior.
Quick join menu now consistently displays server listings and retains results without randomly clearing them.
Workbench recipes correctly reset after server reloads, preventing stale or duplicated recipes.
Neon signs now offer a larger 25mm size option and a colour wheel for custom colours.
Sheep charge attack animation fixed, restoring proper attack behavior.
PT boat turrets now appear correctly on the death screen.
Fixed UI layout issue that could cause interface elements to disappear or misalign.
Corrected AI pathfinding so NPCs no longer walk through fences and navigation volumes now work with the new navmesh.

2026-09-17.summary:
### Crafting & Food
- Rich versions of all pies now require cream and grant buffs such as longer duration, higher yield, increased gene chance, and extra healing.
- New Brioche Bread recipe (2 eggs, 4 cream) provides a 25 % boost to bread stats.
- Stone and cloth costs for several recipes have been reduced and crafting time cut from 30 s to 10 s.

### Combat & Turrets
- Remotely controlled turrets can now damage reactive targets, including when using bows.
- Low‑health heartbeat sound is louder and fades after three seconds of health loss.

### World & Environment
- Distance2D calculations now correctly ignore the Y axis, fixing range checks and related gameplay logic.
- Fixed occasional NaN water level values, preventing abnormal water behavior.
- Triangle foundations no longer connect buildings that only touch at a corner.

### Vehicles & Controls
- A unified 'Swap Seats' button binding has been added to all vehicle action sets.
- Cars now support a reload action and the menu gesture action has been removed.
- Stirring the biofuel generator mounts you in place; releasing stops mounting, and a 'no electricity' status appears if stirred without power.

### Achievements
- New achievements added for leaving a note in another player's mailbox, purchasing from the travelling vendor, and initiating a satellite crash event.

### NPC & AI
- Livestock now spread out when avoiding the trough instead of forming a line, improving their avoidance behavior.

### Quality of Life
- Quick join menu now consistently displays server listings and retains results without randomly clearing them.
- Workbench recipes correctly reset after server reloads, preventing stale or duplicated recipes.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Neon signs now offer a larger 25mm size option and a colour wheel for custom colours.
- Sheep charge attack animation fixed, restoring proper attack behavior.
- PT boat turrets now appear correctly on the death screen.
- Fixed UI layout issue that could cause interface elements to disappear or misalign.
- Corrected AI pathfinding so NPCs no longer walk through fences and navigation volumes now work with the new navmesh.
